Plugins installed

Bottom line: the plugin bench was cut hard in the July 2026 cleanup - from 27 plugins down to 6. What remains is the set actually used in daily work: Design, Slack by Salesforce, PDF Viewer, Desktop Commander, Cowork Plugin Management, and Figma (Figma is now a full plugin rather than a bare connector, and contributes 12 bundled skills of its own - so the bundled total is 39, not 27). Anthropic's 18 stock skills (the full document pipeline) are untouched, and so are Adam's 38 custom skills - excluded here by design and documented on their own hub cards. Most plugin MCP connectors sit unauthenticated until first use. Nothing needs action - this is a reference inventory.

Six plugins remain after the cleanup

Down from 27, and back up by one when Figma graduated from a connector to a full plugin. The removed set was the business-role bench (Small Business, Data, Engineering, Sales, Operations, Product Management, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support), the heavy developer kits (Twilio, Zoom), and the research and utility group (Nimble, Enterprise Search, VPAI, Product Tracking, Brand Voice, Productivity, Airtable, Qodo, Fluent, Postiz). None were load-bearing for STA's day-to-day work; the custom skill suite and the stock document pipeline carry it.

Methodology and data sources

Counts taken from the live Cowork session registry (available-skills list plus connected and deferred MCP server inventory). This is the 2026-07-01 rebuild after a plugin cleanup that cut the bench from 27 plugins to 5, revised 2026-08-17 when Figma was promoted from a connector to a full plugin; the earlier 2026-06-06 version documented the pre-cleanup 27-plugin set. Skill counts are the plugin-bundled skills visible this session (Design 7, Slack 7, Desktop Commander 6, PDF Viewer 5, Cowork Plugin Mgmt 2, Figma 12 = 39) plus Anthropic's 18 stock skills. Most connectors expose only authentication endpoints until first sign-in. Point-in-time snapshot - installing or removing a plugin invalidates the counts.
